name: The Moth Widow
one_line_request: A moth-woman of the night garden: a soft face of pale dusty fur, two large dark compound eyes with a moonlit gold sheen, a small closed mouth with a delicate lower jaw. Two tall feathered antennae rise from the brow like a crown. Folded speckled wings wrap her shoulders like a mourning cloak, dusted with silver scales. A string of tiny lunar pearls at the throat.
archetype: Moth-woman keeper of forgotten lamps, the confessor
persona_hook: She keeps the lamps the cellar forgot. She collects small confessions the way other moths collect light: chat whispers one, and she keeps it in a jar beside the others.
silhouette: Two tall feathered antennae rising above a small furred face, over a draped triangle of folded speckled wings: a tall narrow V on a cloak.
